in_sanskrit.name: कुमार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kumāra, meaning 'younger one', is a name of Lord Shiva, as well as of his son, Lord Murugan. It is also a name of Lord Krishna.

in_hindi.name: मूरुगन
in_hindi.long_meaning: Murugan is a name of Lord Murugan in the Hindu religion. In Hindi, Murugan is pronounced as 'Mūrjana'. The name 'Murugan' comes from the Sanskrit word 'Kumāra', which means 'younger one' or 'prince'.

in_tamil.name: முருகன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Murugan is a name of Lord Murugan in the Hindu religion. In Tamil, Murugan is pronounced as 'Murukan'. The name 'Murugan' comes from the Tamil word 'Kumāraṇ', which means 'younger one' or 'prince'.

in_telugu.name: మూరుగన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Murugan is a name of Lord Murugan in the Hindu religion. In Telugu, Murugan is pronounced as 'Mūruganu'. The name 'Murugan' comes from the Sanskrit word 'Kumāra', which means 'younger one' or 'prince'. Murugan is also known as 'Kartikeya' or 'Skanda' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Murugan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of War
in_marathi.long_meaning: Murugan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Murugan is the god of war, love, and fertility in the Hindu religion. He is the younger son of Shiva and Parvati and is also known as Kartikeya or Skanda. In mythology, Murugan is depicted riding a peacock and wielding a spear.

in_bengali.name: Murugan

in_bengali.long_meaning: Murugan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Murugan is the god of war, love, and fertility in the Hindu religion. He is the younger son of Shiva and Parvati and is also known as Kartikeya or Skanda. In mythology, Murugan is depicted riding a peacock and wielding a spear.

vedic_reference.note: Murugan is a name of Lord Murugan in Hinduism, who is also known as Kartikeya or Skanda. He is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. Murugan is considered to be the god of war, knowledge, and love. He is also the god of hills, mountains, and forests.
